responsibility: This file implements mc’s simple module/file naming policy. It concatenates module names with language extensions, derives stem names under configurable length limits, removes a specified extension when present, and extracts the basename from a path using the module’s directory separator conventions. It is a small utility layer used mainly by mcSearch and the compilation driver when resolving .def and .mod files.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file contains the executable filename-policy logic for mcFileName, including the directory separator constant and the concrete concatenation/slicing used to build or strip names; mcFileName.def only declares those helper routines.
